scope: B00 orchestration contract only; market ingestion B02, hosting B08, calculation B06, CI B01

basket_registry.policy: canonical GitHub main public symbols only; branch-only additions provisional; no private company synthesized OHLCV

tiers.P0: holdings and risk-sensitive core public companies

schedule_intents.policy: Configured poll targets ONLY; not proof of entitlement, rate limit, continuous execution or successful ingest

freshness_policy.live: Only with verified contractual real-time rights, source event timestamp, delivery lag and eligible market session
freshness_policy.observed_current_session: An active-session event within TTD; not assumed real-time
freshness_policy.last_completed_session: Historical session dated previous close, not current live quote
freshness_policy.stale: Active venue source event older than TTD; invalidate dependent current-use NAV/traversal

workers.name: Universe & entitlement
acceptance: Discover all public canonical basket tickers, excluding private company OHLCV
Test per-endpoint and per-symbol rights; preserve NOT_ENTITLED
Include OTC SFTBY and original currencies

workers.name: Historical daily backfill
acceptance: Backfill 200+ completed sessions where listed
Track adjustment basis, corrections, original venue, event/available/ingested timestamps
Never interpolate absent market bars

workers.name: Market session clock
acceptance: Determine regular, extended, closed, half-day and holiday state
Do not claim stale prior closes are live
Record timezone and OTC venue handling

workers.name: Batch snapshot capture
acceptance: Use Massive stock batch snapshot with include_otc=true and provider quota
Do not infer NBBO or live trade from last-minute/day aggregates
Store per-symbol effective timestamps and missing-field status

workers.name: Minute bars and gap repair
acceptance: Use historical 1-minute API for active selected tickers and replay
Paginate and prevent invented empty bars
Reconcile eligible minute aggregates to completed daily sessions

workers.name: FX and ADR conversion
acceptance: Date-match and retain JPY basis and USD FX provenance
Provider last spot FX is NOT_ENTITLED; no live NAV based on historical quote
Validate SFTBY ADR conversion and underlying relationship without inventing factors

workers.name: Integrity and TTD
acceptance: Normalize source ns,ms and ISO timestamps
Reject impossible future prices, duplicate volumes and unsourced quotes
Expire dependent live-use computations on stale price/FX inputs

workers.name: Replay and checkpoint
acceptance: Reconstruct point-in-time snapshots by available/ingested times
Correct observations append-only; no future leakage
Surface complete/stale/missing denominator and state

workers.name: Hosted orchestration and API
acceptance: Run authenticated external hosted worker with source entitlement and durable credentials
Use transactional leases, idempotent job keys and restart-replay tests
Prove remote authenticated health/API and actual poll run; no ChatGPT chat-loop substitute

workers.name: Traversal materializer
acceptance: Consume only coherent validated snapshot IDs
Fail closed when time-dependent FX/price inputs missing or stale
Do not invent calibrated traversal probabilities

incident_policy.not_entitled: Record plan coverage gap, use alternatives only with separate explicit sources
incident_policy.rate_limit: Retry-After, bounded backoff and rate quotas
incident_policy.provider_gap: Missing trades/bar empty intervals not interpolated
incident_policy.session_closed: Freeze dated last completed session close
incident_policy.restart: Leases and event watermarks, deduplicated append-only replay
incident_policy.data_conflict: Quarantine conflicting reports retaining historical evidence

release_gates: B02 200+ session backfill and TTD checks
B08 hosted persistent scheduler with secured separately entitled Massive API credentials
Observed snapshot age during live market session plus legal redistribution/usage confirmation
B06 coherent snapshot traversal no unsupported probabilities
